impact: After ISS-002's probe-layer cause (`nvenc-api-create-failed:15` / version-macro and device-type bugs) was fixed end-to-end in 2026-05-19 Rounds 1–4, the strict probe reaches `ProbeOutcome::Available` on RTX 4080 SUPER / driver 595.71.05. However, `cargo test -p cove-replay-engine --test encoder_session nvenc_one_frame_shm_encode_produces_fmp4_fragment` now executes `configure()` (previously soft-skipped) and returns `Runtime("nvenc-init-failed:12")` = `NV_ENC_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_PARAM`. Most likely cause: `tuningInfo = NV_ENC_TUNING_INFO_UNDEFINED (0)` paired with `NV_ENC_PRESET_P4_GUID`. Additionally, `NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS`, `NV_ENC_LOCK_BITSTREAM`, `NV_ENC_CREATE_INPUT_BUFFER`, `NV_ENC_CREATE_BITSTREAM_BUFFER`, and `NV_ENC_LOCK_INPUT_BUFFER` in helper/src/encoder/backends/nvenc/mod.rs are written in the same dev-style as `NV_ENC_INITIALIZE_PARAMS` was before Round 4 (separate u32 flags where SDK packs bit fields, wrong-sized sub-arrays, missing post-pointer fields); they have not yet been audited against SDK 12.1. `push_frame()` and `drain()` will hit the same class of failure even after configure is green. Blocks T-010c smoke/RC.
title: NVENC encode-path FFI still red after probe fix — nvenc-init-failed:12 / SDK 12.1 struct audit needed
